name: LocalizationFileLoader
src_typeComment: OPTIONAL. Loads a translation file at runtime and layers it over the locales the game shipped with — the answer to "we found a typo in the German text" or "a player translated it into Polish" without rebuilding. Delete this script if you only ever want the LocaleAssets that ship in the registry; nothing else in the folder depends on it.  Keys that the file does not mention are left alone, so a patch file only needs the lines it changes, and a CSV can introduce a language that has no asset at all.

src_serialized.name: format
src_serialized.tooltip: CSV = one sheet with a column per language. JSON = one file holding one language.

src_serialized.name: location
src_serialized.tooltip: Where the file lives. StreamingAssets ships with the build; PersistentDataPath is for a file downloaded or dropped in after install.

src_serialized.name: filePath
src_serialized.tooltip: Path within that location, e.g. "Localization/extra.csv". For Absolute Path, the full path.

src_serialized.name: jsonLocaleCode
src_serialized.tooltip: JSON only: the locale code this file's text belongs to. A CSV names its own languages in the header, so this is ignored for CSV.

src_serialized.name: jsonDisplayName
src_serialized.tooltip: JSON only: the name to show in a language picker if this file introduces a brand-new locale.

src_serialized.name: loadOnStart
src_serialized.tooltip: Load as soon as this component starts. Turn off to call Load() yourself at a controlled moment.

src_serialized.name: activateAfterLoad
src_serialized.tooltip: After loading, switch the game to the first locale the file provided. Useful when the file IS the language the player asked for; leave off when it is just a patch.

src_members.sig: public bool IsLoaded { get; private set; }
src_members.name: IsLoaded

src_members.name: LoadedKeyCount

src_members.comment: Exposed separately so text fetched some other way — a web response, an in-game text box, a test — can go through exactly the same merge path as a file on disk.
